# Łukasz Pietrzak — Full-Stack Developer Portfolio

> Modern, accessible, and high-performance portfolio website showcasing my skills as a Full-Stack Developer. Built with vanilla JavaScript, CSS custom properties, and a service worker. Lighthouse scores: Performance 100, Accessibility 100, Best Practices 100, SEO 100.

Key details about the site owner:
- Name: Łukasz Pietrzak
- Role: Full-Stack Developer with 2+ years of commercial experience
- Email: me@lukaszpietrzak.dev
- Location: Warsaw, Poland (remote work)
- GitHub: https://github.com/kvdpxne
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/kvdpxne
- Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/kvdpxne

The website is a single-page application with all content dynamically rendered. Navigation uses hash-based routing (#section-name). A dark/light theme toggle is available, with preference stored in localStorage. The site requires JavaScript to function properly.

## Structure

- [Hero section](https://lukaszpietrzak.dev/#hero): Introduction with call-to-action buttons (projects, contact)
- [About](https://lukaszpietrzak.dev/#about): Personal introduction with statistics (2+ years experience, 15+ projects, 10+ clients)
- [Career](https://lukaszpietrzak.dev/#career): Timeline showing professional journey (6 entries, descriptions visible on hover)
- [Skills](https://lukaszpietrzak.dev/#skills): Technology stack with proficiency levels (25 technologies, from Expert to Basics)
- [Projects](https://lukaszpietrzak.dev/#projects): Portfolio projects with lazy-loaded cards (ShopFlow, DataViz, AI Writer, Portfolio)
- [Case Study](https://lukaszpietrzak.dev/#case-study): Detailed breakdown of this portfolio website's development process (lazy-loaded)
- [Contact](https://lukaszpietrzak.dev/#contact): Contact form with client-side validation and honeypot spam protection

## Technical Details

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/kvdpxne/portfolio): Complete source code with modular JavaScript architecture
- [Style System](https://github.com/kvdpxne/portfolio/blob/main/css/style.css): CSS custom properties with dark/light theme support
- [Service Worker](https://github.com/kvdpxne/portfolio/blob/main/sw.js): Offline support with cache-first strategy
- [Web Manifest](https://github.com/kvdpxne/portfolio/blob/main/manifest.webmanifest): PWA configuration
